# Page excerpts in the shape PyMuPDF-free extraction produces for the AHA/ACC
# journal PDFs. Four pages, form-feed separated, header lines stripped by the
# loader in test_guidelines_extract.py.
#
# Derived, not copied. The boilerplate strings, the running head and the control
# characters are verbatim artifacts of the real files -- they have to be, they are
# what the parsers are tested against. The body prose around them is written for
# this fixture. Issue #87 rules the source corpus non-redistributable, and a page
# of AHA body text is the copyrighted expression rather than the artifact.
#
# The quirks each page carries are deliberate:
#   page 1  U+0008 backspace after the issue date; no running head (cover page)
#   page 2  em space inside a threshold row; en dash in 130-139; U+2265
#   page 3  soft hyphen mid-word; fi ligature; a private-use icon glyph
#   page 4  narrow no-break space
